assumption_type: Analyst-selected lower/central/upper scenarios, not measurements, probability quantiles, safety limits or organizer counts.
boundary_note: area_factor is scalar area sensitivity, not a measured alternative polygon. Adjacent sectors stay disjoint in baseline geometry.
peak_note: Proxy for near-peak simultaneous attendance conditional on the 14:22 view being representative. True daily maximum unobserved; no summing across times, no turnover multiplier.
